meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: NCS: hides social icon links, blurs or hides cover art, can hide the featured release card, artist names and footer
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome, https://ncs.io/ with an iPhone UA and a desktop UA (the site is one responsive, server-rendered page). No cookie banner, no ads and no pop-ups were rendered in the visit, so the existing generic rules are unchanged and the new rules are content options rather than annoyance fixes (except the social links).

- **Social links**: `header nav a[target="_blank"]:has(img.social)` 3 (Spotify, Instagram, YouTube) and `footer .social-media` 1 (LIVE).
- **Cover art**: `.item .inner .img` 25 release covers (CSS background images, so the whole box is blurred or hidden) and `article.module.details .bg` 1 on the featured release (LIVE).
- **Featured release** `article.module.details` 1, **artist names** `.item .bottom .tags` 25, **footer** `footer` 1 (LIVE).

Not verified: artist and release pages, the global player bar while playing, logged-in pages. Class names are plain and readable (Bootstrap grid plus `item`, `inner`, `img`); no hashed names are used. Library list view (`?display=list`) was not inspected.
